mapper.select: SELECT id, system_code, project_code FROM knowledge_project WHERE system_code=#{systemCode} AND project_code=#{projectCode} ORDER BY id

SELECT c.id,c.component_id component_key,c.name FROM knowledge_component c JOIN knowledge_page p ON p.id=c.page_id WHERE p.system_code=#{systemCode} AND p.project_code=#{projectCode} AND p.page_path=#{pagePath} ORDER BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_component (id, page_id, component_id) SELECT #{id}, id, #{identity.componentId} FROM knowledge_page WHERE system_code=#{identity.systemCode} AND project_code=#{identity.projectCode} AND page_path=#{identity.pagePath} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE component_id=knowledge_component.component_id
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.name,c.description FROM knowledge_component c JOIN knowledge_page p ON p.id=c.page_id WHERE p.system_code=#{systemCode} AND p.project_code=#{projectCode} AND p.page_path=#{pagePath} AND c.component_id=#{componentId} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT id, system_code, project_code, service_code, service_type, local_path FROM knowledge_service WHERE system_code=#{systemCode} AND project_code=#{projectCode} ORDER BY id

SELECT i.id, s.service_code, i.method, i.path, i.name, i.description, i.request_content_type, i.response_content_type FROM knowledge_interface i JOIN knowledge_service s ON s.id=i.service_id WHERE s.system_code=#{systemCode} AND s.project_code=#{projectCode} AND s.service_type='BACKEND' ORDER BY i.id

SELECT a.id, e.id knowledge_id, e.kind, e.title, e.knowledge_type, e.content, e.source, e.status, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.condition_text, a.unconditional, a.exception_text, a.replaces_knowledge_id, r.status replaces_status, r.title replaces_title, r.knowledge_type replaces_type FROM knowledge_entry e JOIN knowledge_applicability a ON a.knowledge_id=e.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_entry r ON r.id=a.replaces_knowledge_id AND r.system_code=e.system_code AND r.project_code=e.project_code WHERE e.system_code=#{systemCode} AND e.project_code=#{projectCode} AND e.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PENDING') AND (a.target_type=SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{key}, ':', 1) AND a.target_id=SUBSTRING(#{key}, LOCATE(':', #{key}) + 1))AND 1=0 ORDER BY e.id, a.id

SELECT id, interface_id, direction, location, parent_id, field_name, field_path, value_type, item_type, required_flag, nullable_flag, business_meaning, technical_description, validation_text FROM knowledge_interface_field WHERE interface_id IN #{id}1=0 ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id, interface_id, name, description, request_body, response_body FROM knowledge_interface_example WHERE interface_id IN #{id}1=0 ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id, interface_id, code, http_status, description, trigger_condition FROM knowledge_interface_error WHERE interface_id IN #{id}1=0 ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,name,description,page_path path FROM knowledge_page WHERE system_code=#{systemCode} AND project_code=#{projectCode} AND page_path=#{pagePath}

SELECT a.id,a.knowledge_id,a.target_type,a.target_id,a.unconditional,a.condition_text,a.exception_text,a.replaces_knowledge_id, c.component_id component_key,c.name,p.page_path path FROM knowledge_applicability a JOIN knowledge_entry e ON e.id=a.knowledge_id JOIN knowledge_component c ON c.id=a.target_id JOIN knowledge_page p ON p.id=c.page_id WHERE a.target_type='COMPONENT' AND e.system_code=#{systemCode} AND e.project_code=#{projectCode} AND p.system_code=#{systemCode} AND p.project_code=#{projectCode} AND e.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PENDING') AND c.id != #{currentComponentId} AND a.knowledge_id IN #{id}1=0 ORDER BY a.knowledge_id,a.id

SELECT e.id,e.id knowledge_id,e.title,e.knowledge_type,e.kind,e.content,e.source,e.status FROM knowledge_entry e WHERE e.system_code=#{systemCode} AND e.project_code=#{projectCode} AND e.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PENDING') AND e.id IN #{id}1=0 ORDER BY e.id

SELECT i.id,i.name,i.description,i.method,i.path,i.request_content_type,i.response_content_type,s.service_code FROM knowledge_interface i JOIN knowledge_service s ON s.id=i.service_id WHERE s.system_code=#{systemCode} AND s.project_code=#{projectCode} AND s.service_type='BACKEND' AND i.id IN #{id}1=0 ORDER BY i.id

SELECT i.id,i.component_id,i.action_name action,i.trigger_condition,i.provided_content,i.response_text response FROM knowledge_component_interaction i JOIN knowledge_component c ON c.id=i.component_id JOIN knowledge_page p ON p.id=c.page_id WHERE c.id=#{currentComponentId} AND p.system_code=#{systemCode} AND p.project_code=#{projectCode} ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id

SELECT r.id,r.interaction_id,i.action_name action,i.trigger_condition,i.provided_content,i.response_text response, s.id source_id,s.component_id source_component_id,s.name source_name,sp.page_path source_page_path, t.id target_id,t.component_id target_component_id,t.name target_name,tp.page_path target_page_path, r.effect_text effect,r.condition_text `condition` FROM ( SELECT outgoing.id FROM knowledge_component_interaction owner JOIN knowledge_component_relation outgoing ON outgoing.interaction_id=owner.id WHERE owner.component_id=#{currentComponentId} UNION SELECT incoming.id FROM knowledge_component_relation incoming WHERE incoming.target_component_id=#{currentComponentId} ) selected JOIN knowledge_component_relation r ON r.id=selected.id JOIN knowledge_component_interaction i ON i.id=r.interaction_id JOIN knowledge_component s ON s.id=i.component_id JOIN knowledge_page sp ON sp.id=s.page_id JOIN knowledge_component t ON t.id=r.target_component_id JOIN knowledge_page tp ON tp.id=t.page_id WHERE (s.id=#{currentComponentId} OR t.id=#{currentComponentId}) AND sp.system_code=#{systemCode} AND sp.project_code=#{projectCode} AND tp.system_code=#{systemCode} AND tp.project_code=#{projectCode} AND s.id != t.id ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id,r.sort_order,r.id

SELECT pf.id, f.id target_id, f.name FROM knowledge_page_flow pf JOIN knowledge_page p ON p.id=pf.page_id JOIN knowledge_flow f ON f.id=pf.flow_id AND f.system_code=p.system_code AND f.project_code=p.project_code WHERE p.system_code=#{systemCode} AND p.project_code=#{projectCode} AND p.page_path=#{pagePath} ORDER BY pf.id
mapper.delete: DELETE ov FROM knowledge_object_version ov JOIN knowledge_change_draft d ON d.id=ov.draft_id AND d.component_id=#{componentId} WHERE ov.system_code=d.system_code AND ov.project_code=d.project_code AND ov.object_type IN ('COMPONENT','KNOWLEDGE','APPLICABILITY','INTERACTION','COMPONENT_RELATION') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT v.system_code, v.project_code, v.object_type, v.object_id FROM knowledge_object_version v LEFT JOIN knowledge_change_draft owner ON owner.id=v.draft_id WHERE owner.component_id IS NULL OR owner.component_id<>#{componentId} GROUP BY v.system_code, v.project_code, v.object_type, v.object_id ) shared WHERE shared.system_code=ov.system_code AND shared.project_code=ov.project_code AND shared.object_type=ov.object_type AND shared.object_id=ov.object_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_component_version cv WHERE cv.component_id<>#{componentId} AND JSON_SEARCH(cv.manifest, 'one', ov.object_id, NULL, '$[*].objectId') IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_applicability a WHERE (a.knowledge_id=ov.object_id OR a.replaces_knowledge_id=ov.object_id) AND (a.target_type<>'COMPONENT' OR a.target_id<>#{componentId}) )
DELETE FROM knowledge_applicability WHERE target_type='COMPONENT' AND target_id=#{componentId}
